visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Both Pointers Move at the Same Speed
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The middle of 1 2 3 4 5 is 3, but the program prints 5.

solution.explanation: The trick only works because fast covers twice the distance of slow. If both move one node at a time, fast ends at the last node together with slow, so slow ends up at the end instead of the middle.
